notes: A big one. Shuffle is a proper mix now — the running order is built as the station plays rather than shuffled once at the start, so a song you've just added can turn up next and nothing gets stuck at the back. Listeners can ask for a song from your station's page (switch it on per station). A playlist can follow a YouTube playlist as well as Spotify and Apple Music — make it collaborative and anyone you share it with can add music to your station. Playlists can be renamed. Song titles now come from the music files themselves, so punctuation and full credits come back. Tools → Tidy up the gaps skips the silence at the start and end of songs. And the app comes back to the station you were working on instead of jumping to the main one every restart.
